purpose: Operate Shire Journey at the highest evidence-safe production throughput without weakening canon, provenance, runtime serialization, target-device performance or Gate 6/7.

live_baseline.note: Warehouse #286 later failed in saturation reporting on an empty Measure-Object Sum StrictMode defect; inventory itself was clean.

throughput_model.rule: Keep every dependency-independent preparation lane busy. Increase batch breadth until a real guard trips; do not slow production because of arbitrary small-batch habits.
throughput_model.long_ci_behavior: DEC-075 bounded polling; continue independent production instead of waiting interactively.

parallel_lanes.scope: Supplied PDFs, mission/world/character/culture source indexing and chapter source architecture
Licensed/public provider staging into persistent warehouse
Mega source candidate scoring/report generation from clean warehouse
PNG/TGA 1K/2K source preparation, channel packing where appropriate, deterministic receipts
FBX skeletal/animation intake, retarget/deformation QC preparation
Landmark, traversal, collision/nav, encounter, dialogue and living-world prep for later regions

parallel_lanes.reason: Exactly one runtime-changing lane; predecessor Gate 6/7 fence

hard_stops: Warehouse inventory integrity failure after active-receipt supersession resolution.
Dangerous payload, invalid provenance/license evidence or blocked final format.
Free warehouse storage below 6 GiB reserve.
Synchronous heavy runtime loading or hard-reference residency regression.
Crowd Spawn/Destroy churn replacing required pooling.
Runtime chapter promotion before predecessor Gate 6/7 acceptance.
Exact-head compile/runtime validation failure for runtime-changing work.
non_blocking_quarantine: One provider unavailable while other providers/lanes remain usable.
One source candidate corrupt or oversized when the containing wave can continue.
One optional category has zero candidates while required landmark/source minimums still pass.
Long CI run queued/in_progress while unrelated safe work exists.

runtime_residency_policy.rule: Large on-disk libraries are allowed. Runtime loads only the active region/zone working set plus bounded transition overlap.
runtime_residency_policy.chapter_design: Prefer multi-bank/zone residency for large future chapters rather than one giant resident bank.
runtime_residency_policy.release_rule: Release obsolete handles only after destination world-state commit is stable.

execution_order: Complete F2-04 Road & Helm's Deep Prep maximum-safe source wave and exact-head validation.
Execute F2-04 source indexing only while persistent warehouse inventory remains clean.
Keep F2-05 siege and all Part II runtime integration disabled until explicit runtime mapping/gates permit it.
Continue P1C01 runtime closure as the sole runtime-changing lane.
Continue Frodo/Gandalf skeletal-candidate source/QC preparation and later source/material/audio/world preparation at maximum safe throughput.
Use target-device profiling before any final runtime residency/performance acceptance.
success_definition: Production lanes remain saturated without violating any hard stop, while runtime integration stays serialized and evidence-backed.
evidence_boundary: Execution architecture and current live warehouse evidence only. No PIE/device/visual/pacing/performance acceptance is implied.

tracks.owns: single serialized UE4 self-hosted build/import/QA integration; evidence collection may run hosted
licensed high-quality source catalogue, candidate ranking, source-only acquisition/QC; sole warehouse writer serialized
Skeletal FBX and animation candidate inventory, rig/smoothing/retarget/deformation source QC
Bag End/Hobbiton/Party Field/roads/water/ferry landscape and material source/placement/LOD/collision QC
NPC pooling/quest/save/audio/localization/Arabic RTL and regression source QA

five_lane_operating_overlay.unbounded_item_count_policy: Do not impose fixed tiny per-wave item ceilings for metadata planning. Stage binary bytes only within provider/legal/available-disk/time/rate/memory/artifact constraints; partition deterministically into bounded safe segments.
five_lane_operating_overlay.truth_boundary: Hosted preparation outputs are candidate/evidence reports, not new downloaded models, UE import or device/visual acceptance.

owner_fast_intake_2026_10_11.rule: Reduce administrative friction; accept lawful technically repairable source formats and automatically convert to UE4.27 compatible FBX/PNG/TGA; reuse receipts and limit repeated tests; process large resource-bounded P1C01 batches while independent regions preparation continues.
